Hanno Chamber of Commerce and Industry and Hanno Blue Return Association are holding tax return consultation sessions.

Schedule: February 9 – March 6, 2026 (Reiwa 7), at multiple locations. Sessions held at Hanno Chamber of Commerce and Industry (Main Conference Room), Haraichiba Community Center, Agano Community Center, and Seimei Community Center. Reception times at each venue are 9:30–12:00 or 13:30–16:00 (last intake 30 minutes to 1 hour before closing time).

Services: Tax professional consultation and submission for income tax (blue return) and consumption tax filings. Consultation with tax office staff available February 9, 17, and 25.

Paper submission: The Chamber of Commerce venue does not accept paper submissions except on February 9 (early filing). Those wishing to file paper returns should use the Community Center sessions.

Other notes: e-Tax (electronic filing) is being promoted, with smartphone filing guidance available. Those filing consumption tax should bring a taxable transaction calculation statement. It is recommended to complete your return form beforehand on the National Tax Agency website, save it to a USB drive, and bring it for a faster process. For details, contact the Hanno Blue Return Association office.

Source (Japanese): https://www.hanno-cci.or.jp/xo_event/xo_event-2351/
